scientific_question: Does retaining and weighting both physically permissible mechanisms transfer between regimes?

calibration.protocol: Strict family-wise split-conformal over true synthetic mothers; mechanism-transfer scores descriptive. Selective bounds apply to mother level with at least one accepted choice.

rules.budget: Both exposure designs have two total-release assays, two hydration reads per coupon and one protected half-inventory assay. No bath read. Properties at action choices remain hidden.
rules.split: Different mother and noise seeds for supervised training, development, probability calibration, risk calibration, final tests, and separately identified mechanism calibration.
rules.controls: Discrete physical model, continuous physical model, trained direct distribution forest and same-physics-feature distribution forest; same features and held labels for algorithm groups. Shared- and shuffled-trajectory predictions preserve per-time empirical marginals.
rules.shift: Held generator uses reversible and inhibited release, state-dependent diffusion and a finite bath. Fitting and native calibration use an irreversible generator. Predictions never get the shift flag or its parameters; optional fresh target risk calibration is labeled separately.

forest.development_rule: minimum held outcome failure, then positive regret, then all-action Brier, then smaller leaf

previous.distinction: All earlier held and calibration splits excluded. Existing four abstract requests and nine candidates preserved.

conditions.labels: Complete accepted-by-model truth is simulated, with independent method-of-lines checks. Real uptake/degradation is independently sourced and separately reported.
conditions.calibration_population: IID parent contexts and independent split seeds within each declared mechanism; outcomes within parent are dependent.
conditions.authenticated_external_documents: Only source metadata, no response-target reuse in the present synthetic protocol.
conditions.completion_boundary: Behavior under independent mechanism shift is empirical. All families and confidence bands are model-relative. No clinical or actual material-time deployment conclusion.

factorization.primary: All-action Brier and positive regret against the same prior with unconditioned Sobol candidates, 256 process solves per case.
factorization.controls: Prior-weight 256; discrete 96; same-info frozen direct forest and physics-assisted forest. New mothers, same test mechanisms as development (no new mechanism confirmation).
factorization.decision: Practical predictive improvement if nominal all-action Brier falls at least .005 with a paired mother-bootstrap interval below zero and mean positive regret does not increase. Shift results descriptive.

spatial_probe.controls: All three library arms share 256 paths, inference laws and candidate actions. Bulk and depth each replace the second hydration read on each legacy probe with one nondestructive reading on one nominal same-geometry witness (two witness readings; same times and noise SD). They both see two original thin-coupon hydration readings, two mobilized values and one dry stock value. Original forest and continuum use legacy reads as separate references. Equal-total count: 128 per distinct query × 2 compared with a reused 256 joint prior. Equal sensor counts do not establish equal wet-lab time or cost.
spatial_probe.primary: Paired change in shift full-catalogue Brier and frozen-choice success for bulk versus unchanged assay and depth versus bulk. Worth pursuing depth if Brier decreases at least .005 with mother interval below 0 and realized success does not decline. Unscaled, no target calibration or fit. Positive regret and actual catalogue oracle also included. Budget-matched draw comparison in nominal parents has the same criterio as preceding sampling protocol; new seeds are disjoint.
spatial_probe.scope: Fresh same-law native and new varied non-linear water parameters under independent exchange family. The prediction library contains only irreversible ions and linear effective water diffusivities. No observation of the mechanism label or hydrodynamic parameters. No hidden release or conductivity or traced outcome reused.

fresh_calibration.criteria: No model fitting or sensor retuning. For each fixed sensor algorithm, report mother-simultaneous upper coverage, width, false sign, accepted requests and unsafe mothers. Use unscaled +90% conformal for prechosen action and catalogue separately. 5% nominal active rate is a descriptive minimum for utility, no conditional rare failure guarantee.
fresh_calibration.contexts: Independent within-mechanism native and exchange-family calibration and test. Shift known to evaluator only. New observation noise and mechanism nuisance seeds in every role.
fresh_calibration.reselect: Among catalogue options with all-window calibrated upper margin <=0 prefer minimum raw P(fail), then median margin, then index. Report this separately from preselected action gating.

event_settings.primary: Fixed-area conductivity divided by thickness for every candidate; original functional thresholds and all times. Repeat equal-depth-packet policies on 25 same-thickness and 27 thickness-varying candidates. Full model frozen. Reuse original learned logistic coefficients. Choose the one ranking and cutoff for each catalogue using 72 fresh development mothers and .035 development risk, 12 minimum active. Certify .10 conditional risk and .10 activity on 340 fresh calibration mothers. Simultaneous .05 via Bonferroni over the 2 locked gates.
event_settings.other_policies: Per-method exact calibration outputs are retained descriptively; do not select an alternative among those based on its calibration test. Marginal unsafe control is distinct from conditional risk and has no activity guarantee.
event_settings.mechanism: Mix is IID Bernoulli per mother. The pure exchange stress test repeats all input and candidate choices under one hidden bath modification with no new measurements or calibration. Compare same 96 synthetic mothers under original vs changed dynamics; validation holds only for original registered laws.
event_settings.estimates: Holdout totals and independent mother proportions, zero in accepted failure count does not mean zero physical risk. All risk and utility targets refer only to dimensionless synthetic setup.
event_settings.subgroup: No subgroup or third regime claim in this paired catalogue comparison.
event_settings.success: Require both gates to certify at the same target and paired held-mother safe issuance improvement with 95% interval above zero to claim improved delivery at the stricter common risk target. If only one gate certifies, report the valid separate result and uncertified point comparisons without same-safety claim. Locations never get hidden mechanism label.
event_settings.held: 128 independent mixed held parents, unflagged Bernoulli mixture using same laws as calibration. Distinct from earlier thickness, strict and ordinary evaluations.

thickness.physical_context: A preformed plane patch of fixed in-plane area. Vary thickness at fixed protected mass of ions per area by adjusting volumetric dose inversely, and retain the original swelling, elasticity and ionic equations. The alternative thickness settings are assumed manufacturable at fixed material chemistry for this synthetic test.
thickness.prediction: Original single seven-read depth packet and fixed nominal witness for every action. Posterior on common uncertain kinetics, nominal water coefficient and preparation perturbations computed once. Original candidate likelihood and 256 latent atoms per action/bath. No extra reads or environment-conditioned training. Enumerate all actions with four original time requests, no new time or response targets.

primary.criterion: Capacity and realized success are evaluated separately. A practical capacity or success gain requires an absolute change of at least .025 with a paired mother bootstrap 95% interval above zero. Adoption of the process policy also requires nonincreasing average common-catalogue positive regret.

thickness.sensitivity: For constant area and through-thickness conduction, compare specimen conductance scaled to the nominal geometry, G*L0/A = sigma / scale, using the same trajectories and original thresholds. Average layer moduli remain unchanged. This is a secondary electrical readout, separate from contact performance or patch force.
thickness.limits: No composition-cost matching beyond same areal bound ion mass, no unmeasured plate support or wet-contact model, and no empirical calibration of the thickness multipliers.

address_fix: Choose disjoint witness RNG blocks 20 million addresses apart, census all possible role and branch addresses, new disjoint mother seeds. The 64/72 original training/development roles had no repeated witness addresses and only those outcomes are reused. The replaced calibration/test certificates have no standing.

tight.observations: Five shared observations, then mid-depth water at 0.4 and one scalar on the same standard witness at 0.8. Adaptive variants choose the second modality using the first and the atlas alone. Common standard normal noise on alternatives for paired precision. Same scalar count and deadline, yet assumed per-instrument noise and no equal cost claim.
tight.selection: On 112 new development mothers, choose a rank and strict cutoff at no more than .05 observed selective risk with 15 active mothers. Choose one alternative only by correct delivery, then fewer unsafe mothers, then deterministic name. Apply identical selection of rank and cutoff to the original two depth observations. If no method qualifies, retain the development negative. Do not tune on the latter roles.

picks.comparison: Best alternate versus retargeted original two-depth packet. Original global policy was silent for this role.

tight.confirmation: Frozen selectors and policies, same scenario mixture, no new mechanism claim. Test each of two locked rules on the 320 independent calibration mothers using .10 risk and activity targets at .025 each. Independently estimate held paired correct-delivery and 95% CI over 160 mothers. Same-risk improvement requires both gates, at least .025 point gain and CI above zero. A lone passing rule supports only its own risk claim. Keep all failures.
tight.frame: One operating request per material state, two states per mother, no cross-use or original multi-request risk guarantee.

phase.constraints: Use only the original 112 developmental mothers as supervised training. All new tuning and gates use fresh roles. Two baseline methods use depth, two new methods use electrical. Choose a single supervised rule per sensor via the same development criterion. Compare both at the same risk/activity targets and at least 2.5 point prespecified paired utility gain. No rule when none locks.
phase.models: Direct same-input ExtraTrees predicting a vector of the five signed clauses, and standardized ridge using the same measurements plus whole and clause-specific physical summaries. Out-of-fold residual vectors are kept joined across clauses and actions. No true mechanism input.
phase.scope: Paired phase-forecast correction, never a new material measurement or full state calibration.

coupon.one_witness_each: Use one witness per arm and the same times .4 and .8. Two hydration scalars at standard or .65 thickness, or first local water and later log G at .65 thickness. Keep measured common five, candidate catalogue and thresholds. Hold the sensor coupon areal stock fixed under thickness change, and same wet-transfer condition. Noise assumptions equal for each type, .016 hydration and .08 on log G. Time/count only, no equivalence in lab cost.
coupon.inputs: Observed process context and seven scalar observations only. No full PDE posterior is supplied to any arm. Same ExtraTrees signed clause regression and paired out-of-fold residual draws across all arms. Both consumed development groups enter training only.
coupon.primary: Thin electrical versus equally thin double-depth witness. Standard double-depth is a secondary fixed control. Use the same prospective development gate per arm, no rule if none locks. 10% conditional risk and activity targets at .05/3 per eligible fixed arm on 360 fresh mothers. All locked arms scored on 192 fresh mothers regardless of certificate. Primary gain large enough if >= .025 and 95% paired interval above zero and both certify. If only one arm certifies, report it as a single policy result and conditional request type.
coupon.evidence: Same specified synthetic population. The thinner sensor is distinct from the final specimen designs.

process_transfer.predicted_hydration: Use the central curve already fitted from independent dense simulated hydration training profiles. Only change D(h) between the same-number, same-prior conservative two physics arms.
process_transfer.direct_model: Matched early inputs, existing ExtraTrees and joint residuals learned from the prior 224 training mothers. It outputs signed window margins. The learned closure used separate dense simulated hydration labels.
process_transfer.geometry: Same .65 fixed-areal-inventory witness and 27 product actions, separate forward histories on each geometry.
process_transfer.comparison: Forecast before revealing 72 new mothers, no hyperparameter choice or new gate. Compare mechanical and electrical full-process paths for both physics arms, and ungated decisions and Brier against all three.
process_transfer.scope: Unmeasured ionic closure unchanged. Simulator family does not confer real patch evidence or certify risk.

mechanism_mixture.basis: Mechanism effect reversal was observed in the earlier 72. New cohort disjoint, same functioning catalogue and inputs.
mechanism_mixture.weights: Prior half each. Compare equal weights with exact discrete marginal witness-likelihood weighting. All 4×32 states within each law have same prior support as the physical comparator. Common assays weight the paired chemistry subspace first. A different law predicts its own two thin witness reads. No per-case or per-mother truth label is used, and observations from the second state are not reused.
mechanism_mixture.baseline: Hold constant and learned single-law models and direct trees. Evaluate pooled and by true generator offline, ungated design only. Neither earlier score nor held outcomes are used to set blending or thresholds.
mechanism_mixture.primary: Unweighted confirmation by whole-mother paired utility and Brier of evidence mixture against equal mixture and original controls.
mechanism_mixture.definition: Likelihood comparison is about compatibility with the two simulated predictor families, not calibrated identification of the true ion mechanism.
